bug_semantics:
In lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex, do_read_chunked_data!/5 recognized the final chunk only when :binary.split/2 produced ["0", "
" <> rest], so an RFC 9112-compliant trailer-bearing ending such as 0
X-T: v

 missed the terminator clause. The generic zero-sized-chunk path then computed a negative to_read, called read_available!/2, accepted a timeout as <<>>, appended no bytes, and tail-recursed with the identical buffer. An unauthenticated HTTP/1 client could therefore pin one connection worker indefinitely and exhaust the listener pool with a small number of connections.
flaw_origin: The smallest causal change is PR #437 member 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e. It narrowed the pre-existing ["0", _] terminal match to ["0", "\r\n" <> rest] and explicitly left trailers unread. That made trailer bytes flow into the already-present non-progress fallback; its direct parent terminated on every zero-size line and therefore did not contain this trailer-triggered recursion. Mainline commit e73e379ab59840e8561b5730878f16e29ab06217 is the squash aggregate, not the smallest BIC.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e shows author Mat Trudel <mat@geeky.net>, committer Mat Trudel <mat@geeky.net>, and only the message 'Fix error where we weren't maintaining tail buffer at the end of chunked reads'; there is no Co-Authored-By trailer, Generated-with trailer, AI identity, or bot author/committer in the BIC commit object.
evidence: ['First-party advisory https://github.com/mtrudel/bandit/security/advisories/GHSA-rf5q-vwxw-gmrf identifies unauthenticated worker-pinning through chunked request trailers, names lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex do_read_chunked_data!/5, links suspected mainline introducer https://github.com/mtrudel/bandit/commit/e73e379ab59840e8561b5730878f16e29ab06217, and links fix https://github.com/mtrudel/bandit/commit/ae3520dfdbfab115c638f8c7f6f6b805db34e1ab.', 'First-party PR #437 evidence at https://github.com/mtrudel/bandit/pull/437 and https://api.github.com/repos/mtrudel/bandit/pulls/437/commits reconstructs two squash members in order: 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e and 335a6cc5497daaf8a3fd246bd903ba81dcd4704d. The first member changes the zero-chunk match and writes the vulnerable mechanism; the second only removes the word TODO from its comment. The one-parent mainline squash e73e379ab59840e8561b5730878f16e29ab06217 combines those member messages.', 'At BIC 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e, lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex:242-244 contains ["0", "\\r\\n" <> rest] and the statement that trailers should be read and ignored; lines 253-263 compute to_read, call read_available!/2 when it is non-positive, append the result, and recurse; lines 290-294 return <<>> on timeout. git log on the BIC with -S for the strict match reports 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e as its origin, while git log -L confirms the corresponding mainline change appears in squash e73e379ab59840e8561b5730878f16e29ab06217.', 'Direct-parent tree verification used 90191d3e120a44482085ad4526280bc233a7ef33:lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex. Its lines 242-243 are ["0", _] -> {IO.iodata_to_binary(body), buffer}; the strict empty-trailer-only match and its trailer comment are absent. A trailer-bearing zero chunk therefore takes the terminal branch in the parent instead of entering the unchanged-buffer recursion.', 'Release-boundary inspection found tag 1.6.0 (3b38b1a35a1562536082d0507574e2af307c9f5a) still has the broad ["0", _] clause, while 1.6.1 (9d86e2756b69dce50cbede6cdc7d0732b28e7276) contains mainline squash e73e379ab59840e8561b5730878f16e29ab06217 and the vulnerable strict clause. Thus the clone supports the first-party advisory page\'s displayed range > 1.6.0 and < 1.11.1; the bundle\'s normalized >= 1.6.0 lower bound includes one tag whose tree lacks the BIC.', 'Tag 1.11.0 (e62619895d0d2584d7ffa57d43ef6f72437dfaff) retains the vulnerable do_read_chunked_data!/5 implementation. git tag --contains ae3520dfdbfab115c638f8c7f6f6b805db34e1ab begins at 1.11.1, whose tag commit is 40a1b8fc924694a0125bbaa7fee101fa43feeb52; its source parses the zero chunk separately, consumes trailers through do_read_headers!/2, and no longer uses the unchanged-buffer recursion.', 'Fix PR #585 is first-party https://github.com/mtrudel/bandit/pull/585. refs/pull/585/head resolves to 32a89b351d09d06b61054daa3bdebb246980ac06, and its reconstructed member chain contains 8207bb660e21cba2bef7fb31a3e7be53f7e8ab4b (replaces the old recursive chunk reader and makes empty reads an error) followed by direct trailer-handling member 32a89b351d09d06b61054daa3bdebb246980ac06 (decodes and ignores trailers while preserving the remaining buffer). The PR-head tree is identical to advisory-linked mainline squash ae3520dfdbfab115c638f8c7f6f6b805db34e1ab. The aggregate also adds a protocol regression test sending 0\\r\\nTrailer: trailer\\r\\n\\r\\n, expecting 200 OK, then successfully reusing the connection.', 'BIC-only attribution check: raw object 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e has human author and committer Mat Trudel and no attribution trailers or bot identity. No PR-body, later-commit, or fix-commit signal was used for the AI verdict.'] Squash decomposition verified 2026-08-29: introducer is a member commit of a GitHub squash landing; decomposed_shas=['190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e'] verified via clone/PR-head ancestry and first-write diff. direct_fix_sha aligned to the landed fix ae3520dfdbfab115c638f8c7f6f6b805db34e1ab (reconciliation 2026-08-29): the previously named commit 32a89b351d09d06b61054daa3bdebb246980ac06 is a sibling branch/backport commit, not an ancestor of the landed fix (merge-base verified).
reasoning: The advisory's attack input maps directly to the source: after splitting a trailer-bearing last chunk, the strict terminator introduced by 190ada4e3f300d5bd55f57eeefc63c1a2f01464e cannot match; parsing size zero with nonempty rest leads to a negative remaining length, an empty timeout read, and recursion without state change. PR #437 was squash-merged as e73e379ab59840e8561b5730878f16e29ab06217, but its public member history is reconstructable and isolates the first member as the smallest BIC; the second member changes only comment text. The BIC's direct parent tree proves the strict vulnerable line absent. The mainline landing first appears in 1.6.1, remains through 1.11.0, and advisory fix ae3520dfdbfab115c638f8c7f6f6b805db34e1ab first ships in 1.11.1. Within the fix squash, 8207bb660e21cba2bef7fb31a3e7be53f7e8ab4b removes the non-progress reader and 32a89b351d09d06b61054daa3bdebb246980ac06 directly implements trailer consumption. Because the raw smallest-BIC commit object contains only human Mat Trudel identities and no AI marker or attribution trailer, the causal verdict is NOT_AI.
